Close/split evidence update 2026-09-07:
- Targeted tests passed on current origin/main worktree: `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_observability_timeout_9313.py tests/scripts/test_observability_memory_9ea3.py tests/unit/test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py -q` -> 50 passed in 137.42s.
- Current CloudWatch 3h window showed `mem_available_percent` 33 datapoints with measured values 23-55% and `container_stats_ok` 33 datapoints, all max=1.
- Per-container RSS is queryable with stable `InstanceId=i-00880b2c7f13527c5,service=<name>` dimensions: gerrit 32 datapoints (last 0.92 GiB, max 1.07 GiB), mcp 32 (last 0.89 GiB, max 2.44 GiB), review-bot 32 (last 0.21 GiB, max 1.74 GiB), opcert 32 (last/max 0.04 GiB).
- Prior ticket evidence records GATE_PEAK_RSS samples and the linear read-memory model; change 2685 merged with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and reduced per-concurrent whole-store read footprint from ~295 MB to ~84 MB.
- The remaining long-horizon/non-code capacity campaign from AC5 was split to `inherited-americium-porpoise` (`ee5d-e3c0-5f97-4bfc`) and linked `discovered_from` this ticket.
